pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular dark brown polygons with sharp, deeply serrated edge boundaries. The spatial distribution is dense with high-frequency pixel-level indentations along the perimeter of each patch.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, light-toned interstitial lattice separating dark patches. Junction nodes are frequent and multi-directional. Pathway thickness varies from narrow channels to broader intersection points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal crest, characterized by short, dark vertical bristles forming a jagged 1D silhouette against the background.
